messages:
Nina (People Ops): Thanks for the great all-hands Q&A — I'm consolidating the leftover leveling/comp/benefits questions here. I'll answer what I can and pull in Finance/Benefits for the rest. Leave follow-ups in-thread. :wave:

Raj (Eng): If I get promoted and the approval happens right before payroll cutoff, will the raise hit the same pay run or the next one? Also, any chance of retro pay?

Nina (People Ops): Short answer: usually the next payroll cycle. If approval occurs before our payroll cutoff for that run we’ll include it; otherwise it applies to the next run. Retro pay is possible but needs manager request within 30 days of the approval timestamp and Finance sign-off. We avoid retro adjustments unless necessary — it creates manual payroll work.

Marta (Manager): What exactly counts as the "approval timestamp" for the 30-day window? Manager sign-off, calibration chair, or People Ops finalization?

Nina (People Ops): It’s the People Ops finalization timestamp in the HR system. That's the authoritative time for payroll and retro eligibility.

Leo (Finance): Adding: if a retro is approved after a payroll has closed, expect the adjustment on the next available payroll; it can take up to 2 pay cycles for manual entries to land. We prorate bonuses by days-at-level when needed.

Raj (Eng): For mid-search level bumps (e.g., L3 -> L4) — should Recruiting update candidate-facing bands immediately or wait until the calibration is locked? Candidates are asking mid-interview.

Nina (People Ops): Update req bands immediately and mark active candidates. Recruiting should notify candidates of the band change and update offer templates. For offers already signed we generally do not retroactively change comp. For unsigned offers, recruiting + hiring manager can reissue per the new band (Finance approves).

Marta (Manager): Parental leave edge-case: an IC goes on leave during open enrollment and misses signing up for a voluntary benefit. Can we do a retro open-enroll exception?

Benefits-Bot: Qualifying life events (birth/adoption) allow mid-year enrollment. If open enrollment was missed due to being on leave, People Ops will evaluate case-by-case — please DM Nina with the employee name and dates and tag @Benefits-Bot to create a ticket.

Ava (CEO): Leadership note — let's make promotion timing clearer to ICs. Nina, can People Ops publish a single-page flowchart/FAQ that covers: approval timestamp, payroll impact, retro window, appeal steps, and who to contact for private cases? Keep it one pager.

Nina (People Ops): Will do. I'll draft the one-pager + a 2-point manager checklist (what to prepare before calibration) and post it here by Friday. I'll pin the doc for a week.

Raj (Eng): Thanks — that will help a lot. Quick extra: equity refresh eligibility after promotion? Heard the guideline is "6 months" but want to confirm.

Nina (People Ops): Guideline = eligible for refresh conversations ~6 months after promotion. Managers can recommend exceptions during comp windows; approvals require manager + People Ops + Finance.

Nina (People Ops): Thanks all. If you have private situations, DM me and include "private appeal" in the subject line. I'll keep this thread pinned for the week. :pushpin:
